jsonld_raw.name: LOMOGRAPHY LOMO'INSTANT AUTOMAT GLASS CAMERA
jsonld_raw.description:
LOMO'INSTANT AUTOMAT GLASS instant camera, exclusive design for Zara Home in collaboration with Lomography.

Includes a multi-coated 38mm wide-angle glass lens, a close-up lens adapter, and a splitzer.
It is compatible with Fujifilm Instax Mini film. Wallet-sized instant photos.

Additional features:
- Larger F/4.5 aperture
- Minimum focusing distance 30cm
- Automatic mode (adjusts exposure and flash)
- Long exposures and multiple exposures
- 3-step focusing system
- Remote control
- Color filters for flash
- Extras: adhesive dots, photo stands, magnetic labels, integrated reflective panel for selfies.
 
Lomography is an innovative company and community in the field of analog photography, known for its commitment to creativity and a free and spontaneous approach.
